general/extracellular_ephys/electrodes/e.description: unique electrode reference from probe contact identifiers

processing/ecephys/.zattrs.description: Intermediate data from extracellular electrophysiology recordings, e.g., LFP.

units/amplitude_cutoff/.zattrs.description: Estimated fraction of missing spikes, based on the amplitude distribution.

units/amplitude_cv_median/.zattrs.description: Median of the coefficient of variation of spike amplitudes within temporal bins.

units/amplitude_cv_range/.zattrs.description: Range of the coefficient of variation of spike amplitudes within temporal bins.

units/amplitude_median/.zattrs.description: Median of the amplitude distributions for each unit in µV.

units/d_prime/.zattrs.description: D-prime metric based on Linear Discriminant Analysis in PCA space.

units/drift_mad/.zattrs.description: Median absolute deviation of the drift signal in µm.

units/drift_ptp/.zattrs.description: Peak-to-peak of the drift signal in µm.

units/drift_std/.zattrs.description: Standard deviation of the drift signal in µm.

units/electrodes/.zattrs.description: the electrodes that each spike unit came from

units/exp_decay/.zattrs.description: Spatial decay of the template amplitude over distance from the extremum channel (1/um). Uses exponential or linear fit based on linear_fit parameter.

units/firing_range/.zattrs.description: Range between the percentiles (default: 5th and 95th) of the firing rates distribution.

units/firing_rate/.zattrs.description: Firing rate (spikes per second) for each unit across all segments.

units/isi_violations_count/.zattrs.description: Count of ISI violations for each unit.

units/isi_violations_ratio/.zattrs.description: Ratio of ISI violations for each unit.

units/isolation_distance/.zattrs.description: Isolation distance metric based on Mahalanobis distance.

units/l_ratio/.zattrs.description: L-ratio metric based on Mahalanobis distance.

units/main_peak_to_trough_ratio/.zattrs.description: Ratio of main peak amplitude to trough amplitude

units/main_to_next_extremum_duration/.za.description: Duration in seconds from main extremum to next extremum.

units/nn_hit_rate/.zattrs.description: Nearest neighbor hit rate metric based on PCA space.

units/nn_miss_rate/.zattrs.description: Nearest neighbor miss rate metric based on PCA space.

units/noise_cutoff/.zattrs.description: Estimated metric based on the amplitude distribution indicating how many standard deviations the lower-amplitude bins lie from the mean of the high-amplitude bins.

units/noise_ratio/.zattrs.description: Ratio of counts in the lower-amplitude bins to the count in the highest bin.

units/num_negative_peaks/.zattrs.description: Number of negative peaks (troughs) in the template

units/num_positive_peaks/.zattrs.description: Number of positive peaks in the template

units/num_spikes/.zattrs.description: Total number of spikes for each unit across all segments.

units/peak_after_to_trough_ratio/.zattrs.description: Ratio of peak after amplitude to trough amplitude

units/peak_after_width/.zattrs.description: Width of the main peak after trough in seconds

units/peak_before_to_peak_after_ratio/.z.description: Ratio of peak before amplitude to peak after amplitude

units/peak_before_to_trough_ratio/.zattr.description: Ratio of peak before amplitude to trough amplitude

units/peak_before_width/.zattrs.description: Width of the main peak before trough in seconds

units/peak_half_width/.zattrs.description: Duration in s at half the amplitude of the peak (maximum) of the template.

units/peak_to_trough_duration/.zattrs.description: Duration in seconds between the trough (minimum) and the next peak (maximum) of the template.

units/presence_ratio/.zattrs.description: Fraction of time the unit is active.

units/recovery_slope/.zattrs.description: Slope of the recovery phase of the template, after the peak (maximum) returning to baseline in µV/s.

units/repolarization_slope/.zattrs.description: Slope of the repolarization phase of the template, between the trough (minimum) and return to baseline in µV/s.

units/rp_contamination/.zattrs.description: Refractory period contamination described in Llobet & Wyngaard 2022.

units/sd_ratio/.zattrs.description: Ratio between the standard deviation of spike amplitudes and the standard deviation of noise.

units/silhouette/.zattrs.description: Silhouette score metric based on PCA space.

units/sliding_rp_violation/.zattrs.description: Minimum contamination at 90% confidence using sliding refractory period method.

units/snr/.zattrs.description: Signal to noise ratio for each unit.

units/spike_times/.zattrs.description: the spike times for each unit in seconds

units/spread/.zattrs.description: Spread of the template amplitude in µm, calculated as the distance between channels whose templates exceed the spread_threshold.

units/sync_spike_2/.zattrs.description: Fraction of spikes that are synchronous with at least one other spike.

units/sync_spike_4/.zattrs.description: Fraction of spikes that are synchronous with at least three other spikes.

units/sync_spike_8/.zattrs.description: Fraction of spikes that are synchronous with at least seven other spikes.

units/trough_half_width/.zattrs.description: Duration in s at half the amplitude of the trough (minimum) of the template.

units/trough_width/.zattrs.description: Width of the main trough in seconds

units/velocity_above/.zattrs.description: Velocity of the spike propagation above the max channel in µm/ms

units/velocity_below/.zattrs.description: Velocity of the spike propagation below the max channel in µm/ms

units/waveform_baseline_flatness/.zattrs.description: Ratio of max baseline amplitude to max waveform amplitude. Lower = flatter baseline.

units/waveform_mean/.zattrs.description: the spike waveform mean for each spike unit

units/waveform_sd/.zattrs.description: the spike waveform standard deviation for each spike unit
